def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n_steps = 60
    dt = duration_s / (n_steps - 1)
    points = np.empty((n_runs, n_steps, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    lat0 = np.full(n_runs, start[0])
    lon0 = np.full(n_runs, start[1])
    points[:, 0, 0] = lat0
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon0
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0
    # Constants:
    bearing_south = np.pi * 3/2  # radians
    step_m = 890 / (n_steps - 1)  # roughly 15 m per step toward water
    for i in range(1, n_steps):
        # Advance all walkers along southern bearing by step_m
        lat_new, lon_new = terrain.offset(points[:, i-1, 0], points[:, i-1, 1], bearing_south, step_m)
        lat_new, lon_new = terrain.clamp(lat_new, lon_new)
        points[:, i, 0] = lat_new
        points[:, i, 1] = lon_new
        points[:, i, 2] = points[:, i-1, 2] + dt
    inside = terrain.inside(points[:, -1, 0], points[:, -1, 1])
    return points, inside
